questions.why: Anupam Sinha wrote and drew the hero for Raj Comics.

questions.q: What is the title of Dhruva's debut story, GENL #74?
questions.why: He debuted in April 1987 in Pratishodh Ki Jwala.

questions.q: In which year did Super Commando Dhruva debut?
questions.why: Dhruva appeared in 1987, one year after Nagraj.

questions.q: Which city is Dhruva's home and headquarters?
questions.why: Dhruva is based in Rajnagar, home of the Commando Force.

questions.q: What unusual ability does Dhruva have beyond his circus training?
options: He can fly using mechanical wings
He can talk to most animals
questions.why: He has no superpowers, but he can communicate with most animals and birds.

questions.q: Who adopts Dhruva after his parents die in a circus fire?
questions.why: Rajan Mehra, a police chief, adopted him after the fire that killed his parents.

questions.q: Which superheroine is Dhruva's foster sister?
questions.why: Shweta, his foster sister, is the heroine Chandika.

questions.q: What does Dhruva's right-hand bracelet launch?
questions.why: A bracelet fires star-blades, while the left one shoots a grappling star-line.

questions.q: Who is the first and only person to learn the secret identity of Dhruva's foster sister?
questions.why: Natasha, Grand Master Robo's daughter and Dhruva's love interest, alone discovers the secret.

questions.q: Which government-approved team did Dhruva found?
questions.why: He founded the Commando Force with cadets Peter Massy, Karim Shah and Renu.
